T-002 and T-003 (high) are justified via the policy's 'silent defect causes material harm' clause: security-spec.md#threat-considerations states a validator that best-effort-parses malformed input 'would weaken every downstream gate built on it', and both tasks implement substantive fail-closed parsing/structural/cross-reference logic (tasks.md:175-192, 300-313), not UI-copy/CSS/docs/test-only work, so no over-classification. T-004 (medium) is real behavioral test authoring per its own rationale ('this task ships test code only... real assertions, not cosmetic', tasks.md:409-417), matching medium rather than low. No task under-classifies a sentinel surface (authentication, authorization, payment, PII storage, data migration, externally-visible API contract) as low/medium.

(tasks.md:275). T-003 (Risk: high) Done When includes the same pair ('Red→Green evidence captured', tasks.md:369-370; 'Independent review verdict recorded for this task.', tasks.md:383). Neither is Risk: critical, so no second-approver/signed-bundle item is required. T-001 and T-004 are Risk: medium, so this check does not apply to them.

T-002's Scope allocates AC-012, AC-014, AC-016 through AC-024 to itself — 65 of the feature's 73 total negative fixtures (tasks.md:232-242, cross-checked against design.md#test-strategy's fixture tally '7+2+3+3+4+7+2+8+29'), spanning fail-closed parsing, version dispatch, and the full ordered structural-check pass (type/required-key/pattern/minLength/minItems) for both sh and ps1 twins in a single task. Its Done When list (tasks.md:254-279) has 11 distinct checkbox items (counted programmatically), exceeding the '>eight distinct verifiable items' oversized-task indicator. T-003 (tasks.md:369-385, 9 items) and T-004 (tasks.md:480-501, 9 items) each also exceed the 8-item threshold, showing a broader pattern of Done-When lists sized past a single focused session across this task set.

T-002 (functional: validator structural pass) owns extensive negative/error-path ACs — AC-012, AC-014, AC-016, AC-017 (fail-closed: truncated JSON and >10MB file), AC-018 through AC-024 (tasks.md:232-242) — well beyond happy-path coverage. T-003 (functional: cross-reference checks) owns AC-006 through AC-011 and AC-022, including the AC-008 self-reference edge case (tasks.md:349-359). T-001 (functional: schema authoring) itself carries only AC-001/AC-002 (structural/non-regression, happy-path), but has an associated error-path test task per the check's own carve-out: T-002 is Blocked by T-001 and its Scope explicitly exercises the negative-fixture suite (AC-014/016/018/019/020/021/023/024) against every field T-001's schema declares (tasks.md:210-213, 227-229). T-004 is test-only per its own Risk Rationale ('this task ships test code only', tasks.md:409-410) and is excluded from this check's non-test/non-infrastructure scope.

Every TEST-NNN in acceptance-tests.md's AC table (TEST-001..026) carries an explicit Test Type column value that names its own scope accurately (e.g. 'structural (schema file)' TEST-001, 'non-regression (byte 比較)' TEST-002, 'positive fixture' TEST-003/004/005/025/026, 'negative fixture' TEST-006..012/014/016..024, 'twin parity' TEST-013), and every row is keyed to a specific AC-NNN in the same row. TEST-013's 'twin parity' label accurately reflects that it exercises two components (the .sh and .ps1 validator twins) together rather than being mislabeled as a narrower unit test. No test task's declared type is inconsistent with its described scope.

T-002 (Risk: high, tasks.md:175) and T-003 (Risk: high, tasks.md:300) carry no Rollback: field and no Done When item addressing revert. T-002's full Done When list (tasks.md:254-279) and T-003's (tasks.md:369-385) contain no feature-flag reference, no migration-rollback-script reference, and no 'Rollback procedure documented and tested' item. design.md#deployment--ci-plan and infra-spec.md#rollback do record a feature-level rollback ('3ファイルの削除のみ' / 'Rollback = delete the three files'), but neither T-002's nor T-003's Must Read or Scope section references that section, so the rollback consideration is not carried into either high-risk task's own planned evidence.

CHANGELOG.md is edited by all four tasks but execution is fully serialized by the same Blockers chain, so no uncoordinated parallel overlap exists.

T-002's Blockers: T-001 is justified in-task ('the structural pass enforces the declaration T-001 writes, and the suite file T-001 creates is where these fixtures live', tasks.md:227-229). T-003's Blockers: T-002 is justified ('these checks extend the same two script files and run after the structural pass in the design.md pipeline order', tasks.md:344-346). T-001 declares no Blockers, consistent with being the first task. No spurious or missing blocker found.

SKIP: no bugfix or debugging task in scope. All four tasks (T-001..T-004) author new additive artifacts (v2 schema, validator twins, fixture corpus) per requirements.md's Overview; none is scoped as a bugfix, regression fix, debugging, flaky-test resolution, or incident remediation.
